note: The Emberborn grant is defensive and continuous, which is what a body needs when its home air is stone. The line's concentration is thin because it was crossed once with the mineral stock and never again.
The recorded reason this line sits alongside the stone line is a single shared conception with the mineral-fire crossing.
Two generations of pure pairing is the authored bar; the documented salt-water crossing is what a non-pure pairing produces instead.
A line carried carefully across four centuries belongs to a household with a four-century memory. Nothing about this is a stat change; it is who keeps the record.
The common, dependable concentration is what household mixing averages toward, and a cross that spreads along trade routes is exactly what household mixing averages toward.
The documented version of what the clan's cull produced by politics alone: a cross that widens range and does not raise the ceiling.
A line with no recorded origin and no household that will admit to it is the standing question this domain cannot close, and an Unwritten is the one case where no origin was ever written down.
Neither has a genealogy. The structural similarity is the honest reason to record them side by side rather than to claim a descent nobody can evidence.
Structural opposition over a resource, and the resource is the commonborn population itself: thornline's habitat is a species, so the two cannot both be comfortable in one place.
The default body belongs to the default tier. It is everywhere because it is unremarkable, which is the same fact twice.

A deadlight is a commonborn body with the qi component left out of it, and it cultivates the mind path. The pair is the proof that commonborn's closed path is caused by the absence of a cause rather than by its own anatomy.
Stoneborn are cairnborn bred back toward flesh. The density survives as the physique; the interior comes apart into ordinary organs and a dantian becomes thinkable again.
The density is only affordable where there is high country to carry. Remove it and stoneborn are a body with nowhere to put its weight.
Both are commonborn pushed toward stillness. Glasskin took it to vitrification and closed every path; stoneborn stopped short, kept a dantian, and paid for it with a seventeenth-realm ceiling.
A body that runs hot and short belongs where the court sits. It is the only warm country that can keep one alive at speed.
The grit adaptation is a fire-adjacent body plan solving the same problem from the other side, and the two share a belt.
The long-lived water-adapted body is a high-country body: the watered peaks are the only water deep enough to hold one.
The longest-lived bodies in the record make the richest corpses. Carrionfolk read the dead of every long-lived species, and the tidecaller dead are the richest reading there is.
The baseline frame with one organ system rebuilt. Nothing else about it was invented, which is why it crosses so freely.
The dry interior pan is the one place surface water is guaranteed and everything else is dying.
The Saltledger answers access with a ledger, and the saltfolk are the only population that cannot simply leave the pan when the rate goes up.
The floodplain margin is the band neither dry-land nor open-water selection could take, so it was left open.
An amphibian body in a watered world is pushed toward the tidecaller's plan and stops halfway, which is what makes the marshfolk a distinct body rather than a variant.
Reed is burned to clear marsh for grazing. The ashwalkers need the belt and the marshfolk need the reed, and neither of them can move.
A baseline frame with a filter organ and a mineral load. The sieve is the invention; the rest is ordinary.
The volcanic belt is the only surface where a mineral-processing economy is possible at all.
Both solve the same problem of living in hot grit, from opposite ends: the emberblood runs hot, the ashwalker runs cool and filters.
A baseline frame with a nervous system handed to a symbiont. The tissue underneath is not specialised, which is why the colony could be threaded through it.
The peaks are the only high ground here with cave depth worth colonising.
Both are obligate symbiotes: an organ function handed to a partner that then becomes load-bearing. They are the domain's two clean examples of the same arrangement.
Shaped for high-country load paths, and the high country is where there is something for a masonry body to hold.
Every court builds with them, and a cairnborn is keyed into the structure rather than placed in it. This is not tenancy.

A keyed body has no independent existence: no realm, no graft, no relocation, and no line that ever produced one another. Every unanswered question about their origin is where a no-recorded-origin line and a no-ancestry body meet.
A baseline frame optimised for keeping rather than getting. The whole divergence is in marrow turnover.
Temperate upland: quiet, long-lived, and defensible enough that a slow body can afford to be slow.
Two independent longevity strategies in one region — one renewing neural tissue, one renewing bone. Neither works without the other as a comparison, which is why the two record each other constantly.
A line whose value is that it can be kept for four hundred years is the natural carrier of the default household concentration, and the household concentration is what it is kept for.
The leeward side of anything that kills in quantity. It has no homeland of its own; it has a gradient.
Carrionfolk find what is left and ashjackal arrive second. The order is not negotiable and neither party chooses it.
Predation on foals. The ashwalker herd instinct does not distinguish and the ashjackal pack does not withdraw, and both are right about their own evidence.
An elemental body and a scavenger are the same ecology answered twice: the belt sustains both because death there is frequent and unattended.
A frame that kept the plant plan it was engineered from, which is to say it never stopped being a crop.
Deep temperate soil under cover, with a growing season long enough to root in and a winter they can sit out.
Both are obligate partners in a dark substrate. Neither could be worked at depth without the other and the exchange has never been priced.
Both process rock into protein. One filters it out of the air and one pulls it out of the soil, and the belt has both.
Not literally descended: an elemental body that metabolises fire is the same metabolic commitment taken past a point an organic body cannot follow.
Only where the elemental law slot resolves to fire. A world that spends the slot on cold produces a different body entirely, and there is only one species per slot.
The court's heat is the densest continuous fire in the setting, which is why the population is dense there and thin everywhere else.
A cinderkin does not distinguish glass from any other fuel when it is hungry. This single interaction destroyed a species, and it is the clearest evidence in the record that an element is a process.
A baseline frame with almost no muscle and an enormous small intestine. The muscle loss is the price of the tube.
Battlefield margin, execution ground, graveyard hinterland: wherever death concentrates, and nowhere else.
The longest-lived bodies in the record make the richest corpses, which set the carrionfolk's whole economic niche and its reading habits.
Both are what is left when a death is not fully finished. A carrionfolk reads what qi did to a corpse; a wake is what people said about it afterwards.
One object. There has never been a wilderness population of this species and there cannot be one.
The peaks are the only deep inland ground here, and the seal is somewhere under them.
Both are bodies defined by what holds them up rather than by what they are made of, and both have no ancestry anybody can evidence.
The object is still running. Whatever is still running is feeding them, and that is the only reason any of this is knowable.
A wake's shape is always a human shape, because human shape is what qi memory holds most densely. There is no record of a wake that looked like anything else.
Exact opposites from the same cause. A wake is entirely made of what people think was there; an echoless has nothing and is therefore exactly what everyone expects to see.
Neither has a genealogy. Recorded as resemblance, not descent, because no descent can be evidenced for either.
The finding and the problem. Every test that works on a Commonborn works on an echoless, so there is no procedure that tells them apart.
A wake consumes attention to stay real. An echoless is what attention produces when there is nothing behind it. Neither survives being the subject of the other.
Anywhere a life law has been permitted to sit low for a long time. It needs no homeland, which is exactly the difficulty with it.
Seen to have every organ the ladder requires and more of each than the ladder defines. The excess is the whole species.
A site where the life law has been pushed past its authored ceiling of 1.0. It does not spread and it does not persist.
Both are what a life law produces when it is not behaving. One is the floor case and one is the ceiling case and the record only needs the two ends.
A body carrying more than its law can inscribe, and a line with no inscribeable origin. The pairing is a question, not an answer.
Its habitat is a species rather than a place, so it is everywhere a commonborn population is dense and nowhere else.
Obligate. The colony cannot finish developing outside a living body and the commonborn population is the whole range.
Both hand an organ function to a partner. A deadlight shows what the arrangement costs when the partner is inert instead of answering.
The record's standing suspect for the unrecorded-origin line. Named as influence, not descent, because the evidence is a resemblance and nothing more.
A commonborn lineage under sustained selection toward stillness, which is the same mistake as asking a body not to age.
One cold, dry, mineral-rich mountain. It was the last place the silicate replacement could proceed without the body rejecting it, and the last cohort was the only one left.
Not a choice. A cinderkin is not a flame around a body, it is a body, and it does not distinguish glass from fuel. This edge is the destruction and it is causal in the direction recorded.
One basin. The gracility is real across every specimen, so this is a population and not a set of remains.
The basin brine was diluted rather than drained, which means there is no event, no villain and no body to point at. One element changed concentration.

The heat is what drove the evaporation that concentrated the brine in the first place, and the basin was never re-concentrated. The cheapest extinction in the record has a cause and it is not a species.
Alpine meadow and cold steppe, in the high country. A longwinter needs a real winter, and this is the only ground here that reliably provides one.
The lineage came down from the high tier rather than being authored on the mortal steppe, which is why it is the only cold-adapted body in the record that is native nowhere else.

Two bodies that store and wait. The marshfolk bank a season of fat in a brood pouch and the longwinter banks eleven months of the same, and they are the two species on this list whose strategy is a schedule.
A baseline frame with a fat layer, a lowered core and a reduced frame. Nothing else was invented, which is why it crosses so freely.
An ecotype on one basin's saturated floor: the saltfolk plan with tolerance up and mobility down, nothing invented.
The clan owns the brine line, and the subspecies cannot leave it, so access to a substrate is administered by a counting house. This is the single fact that keeps the population where it is.
A replacement symbiont in the same body plan. The difference is one mineral lattice where the hyphal colony was.
The bloom is a silicate, and the mineral replacement is the same process the glasskin pushed too far. A deadlight is that lineage's slowest possible version.
Both want the same host tissue and neither will yield it. The deadlight's bloom is inert, so the thornline colony and it cannot coexist in one body at all.
The mineral parent donates the frame and the ceiling: ordinal 4, inherited unchanged, because heat is not a second organ.
The fire parent donates the throughput and nothing else. The density doubles the fire parent's lifespan and the lifespan is still the reason this body is a problem.
Takes the split penetrating vessel with it: the cross widened the range and left the eleventh-realm ceiling exactly where the salt parent had it.
Takes the sensory apparatus and the two-chemistry kidney. This is the only body in the record that can cross a shoreline without a ritual.
Contributes the fastest cultivation rate in the record and the shortest lifespan of any body with a realm above the fourth.
Contributes the mineral load in the blood, the closed mind path and the eighth-realm ceiling, and then the fire half makes all three arrive sooner.
The colony's ceiling, routing and closed mind path, all of them inherited rather than authored. The hybrid is the case the parasite record refers to.
The host supplies the frame, the throughput and the only reachable registry. Neither half is anatomically dominant and the boundary is visible only under instrumentation.
A cull of this configuration is the only kind of narrowing that could ever be safe, which is a late vindication of a political act and not an anatomical one.
